title: FLUX.2 Small Decoder (Distilled VAE)
summary: A distilled Variational Autoencoder (VAE) decoder designed to optimize inference performance for the FLUX.2 model family. It significantly reduces VRAM usage and increases decoding speed with minimal loss in visual quality.
research_notes: Licensed under Apache 2.0; provides approximately 1.4x faster decoding and a 44% reduction in parameter count compared to the standard FLUX.2 decoder.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026 as a key efficiency update for the FLUX.2 ecosystem, following the flagship FLUX.2 [dev] release in late 2025. It is now standard for consumer-grade inference pipelines.
